title: Prison of Heavenly Way
next_chapter_hook: In the void, the eyes that transcended the Heavenly Way fully opened, staring directly at Chen Ji—it saw Chen Ji, and Chen Ji finally saw it.

text.content: Chen Ji's footsteps froze. The voice was like a bell tolling through countless ages, making his heart burn. He opened his mouth, but twenty years of forbearance and scheming could not find a suitable word at this moment. "Father..." His voice was hoarse, unlike himself. "I'm late." The light at his core trembled faintly, as if responding to this far-too-late call. The cold wind howled through the temporal rift, yet could not disperse that warmth of blood connection.

dialogue.content: "Not late." Chen Tianming's voice rang out again, carrying the tranquility of a thousand years of沉淀. "The chess game isn't over, and you came at just the right time. Your father waited too long—not begrudging this moment—but those who made others wait, they owe too much." Guided by the light, an ancient stone door loomed into view, covered in dense chess pattern carvings, each line telling the tale of a fallen chess player.

text.content: The void before the stone door suddenly twisted. A phantom solidified—a老者 with a blurred face, wearing the black robe of a Tianji Pavilion chess player, eye sockets empty yet seeming to penetrate everything. "Another fool who tries to take away the 'Prison'." The old man's voice scraped like rusty iron. "I am the Third Generation Chess Player, a failure whose name was erased by the Heavenly Eye. If you wish to pass, there is only one trial—" The phantom raised its hand, pointing at Chen Ji's chest. "Abandon the Tianji Record, or fill it with your own destiny."

Chen Ji looked around, only then noticing the countless will projections watching him from the cracks on both sides of the stone door—some angry, some sorrowful, some cold. Each projection was someone who had once controlled the Tianji Record, all of them having come this far, yet all having failed. The Heavenly Fate value pulsed faintly within him—that was his only remaining trump card. Consuming 5 points could foresight events within three hours, but if the trial required him to write his destiny...

choice.prompt: The Third Generation Chess Player's will projection posed a choice: abandon the Tianji Record, or fill it with your own destiny. You must make a choice.

choices.text: Write destiny with the Tianji Record
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment to record part of your fate trajectory as the price for passing. Risk unknown, but can preserve the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_reward: Gain trial passage qualification, may trigger inheritance from past chess players
choices.risk_hint: Each time the Tianji Record writes a destiny, it accelerates the backlash

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly opened the Tianji Record. The golden patterns on the fragment writhed like living things. He bit his fingertip, using blood as ink, and wrote a single character on the blank page—"Chess". The moment the characters fell, the stone door shook violently. The Third Generation Chess Player's phantom stumbled back, and even in those empty eye sockets, a flash of terror appeared. "You... you wrote 'Chess'? Not your own fate?"

dialogue.content: "I am a chess player." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "I never bet my life—I bet others' lives." He raised his head, staring directly at those countless will projections. "Past predecessors, you lost because you always tried to fill that hole with your own lives. But a true chess player—makes others fill it for them." The chess pattern lines on the stone door began flashing frantically, as if responding to his declaration.

choices.text: Question the nature of the trial
choices.description: This trial itself might be a trap. The will projections of chess players have long been corrupted by the Heavenly Eye—their 'experience' cannot be trusted.
choices.visible_reward: May see through the trial's truth and gain extra information
choices.risk_hint: May anger the projections, causing trial difficulty to skyrocket

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer immediately. Instead, he slowly closed his eyes, pouring a thread of Heavenly Fate into the Tianji Record. The golden patterns on the fragment flashed frantically. Three breaths later, a blurry image formed in his mind—not prophecy, but memory fragments. He saw it! The Third Generation Chess Player didn't die in the trial, but rather... "You've been turned by the Heavenly Eye." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open. "You're guarding the gate for it, not for the Tianji Pavilion."

Silence fell before the stone door. The phantom's expression froze for an instant, then burst into a piercing laugh. "Turned? No, child, you're too naive." The phantom began to distort, black patterns spreading from its feet. "The Heavenly Eye has never turned anyone—it merely shows you the truth. The Tianji Record itself is a prison, and you chess players are just birds in a cage, unaware of it."

choices.text: Use their own methods against them
choices.description: Since this is a will trial, use the will of past chess players to oppose them. Absorb their failed experience using the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger will conflict, Heavenly Fate value fluctuating violently
choices.visible_reward: Gain partial will empowerment from past chess players
choices.risk_hint: If defeated in will conflict, may be devoured by past chess players

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled—that gentle smile that made one's flesh crawl. "Many thanks for the reminder, predecessor." He raised the Tianji Record high, golden light blazing. "Since this is a will trial, let predecessors see—what it means to be a promising newcomer." The fragment flipped violently, countless golden threads shooting out, piercing into those will projections. Screams and curses rang from both sides of the stone door, but Chen Ji ignored them all.

dialogue.content: "The lessons of your failures, I will absorb them all." Chen Ji's voice rang particularly clear in the golden light. "The grudges you've left behind, I will settle them for you." At his brow center, a new pattern was slowly forming—the mark of past chess players' wills fused together. "In exchange, I will erase your names from the Heavenly Eye's chessboard." The words fell, and the stone door burst open with a thunderous roar.

text.content: Beyond the stone door was a suffocating darkness. Unlike the previous temporal rifts, this darkness was alive—it writhed, breathed, devouring all light and sound. Chen Ji's Tianji Record fragment trembled violently, as if issuing some warning. "Be careful." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice emerged from the pages, rarely carrying a hint of solemnity. "This is the deepest part of the Heavenly Prison. Where your father is trapped... is also where the Heavenly Eye's gaze is strongest."

In the depths of darkness, a faint blue light caught Chen Ji's attention. The light flickered like a dying heart struggling. He quickened his pace,穿过层层叠叠的黑暗，终于看清了那光源——一个由无数金色锁链交织而成的巨大茧房。茧房中央，一个模糊的人影正被死死缠绕其中，那人影的胸口处，一枚残破的天机录核心正在散发着最后的光芒。

As Chen Ji approached the cocoon, a cold voice came from all directions: "Forty-seventh Generation Chess Player, Chen Ji." The voice carried no emotion, yet it made Chen Ji's soul churn with dread. "You've finally come. Three years and seven months later than predicted." Chen Ji looked around, seeing nothing—only darkness, that cocoon, and those eyes slowly opening in the darkness.

"You've been waiting for me?" Chen Ji's voice was unexpectedly calm. "Of course." Those eyes blinked, the pupils reflecting countless chessboard images—on every board, a piece representing Chen Ji. "From the moment the Tianji Record chose you, you were already on my chessboard. You think you're a chess player? No, child, you're just the forty-ninth piece I've waited three thousand years for." Chen Tianming in the cocoon struggled violently, seemingly trying to stop something.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Forty-ninth piece—this meant before him, forty-eight people had been chosen and eliminated by this so-called "Heavenly Eye." Those past chess players, those predecessors whose wills he had absorbed with the Tianji Record... "So this is the truth." Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile more tragic than crying. "The Tianji Record isn't a prophecy book—it's a prison. You're not chess players—you're... lambs waiting to be slaughtered."

"No, you're wrong." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of playfulness. "The Tianji Record is indeed a prison, but what it imprisons isn't you—it's this world's fear of fate." Those eyes slowly drew near, pupils beginning to show Chen Ji's entire life: a childhood of being trampled, the humiliation at Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao's suspicions, Chen Nian's disappearance... "You think you're scheming against the world? No, every struggle of yours has been in my plans."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye revealed an earth-shattering truth—Chen Ji is merely the forty-ninth piece, everything has been in its plans. Now you must prove: are you the chess player, or a piece?

choices.text: Acknowledge it as the chess player
choices.description: Since the Heavenly Eye is so confident, temporarily show weakness, let it lower its guard. Seek an opportunity to turn the tables in desperation.
choices.visible_cost: Dignity damaged, may be completely suppressed by the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Gain breathing room, fight for time to make a comeback
choices.risk_hint: If judged as surrendering, will completely lose qualification to resist

text.content: Chen Ji slowly lowered his head, his voice unexpectedly calm: "You're right." The Heavenly Eye seemed somewhat surprised, its pupils slightly narrowing. "Oh? Surrendering so readily?" Chen Ji still had his head lowered, but the corner of his mouth lifted into an almost imperceptible curve. "I surrender, but I don't accept my fate." His voice abruptly turned cold. "You've calculated everything, yet missed one thing—"

"I was never alone." Before the words even finished, Chen Tianming in the cocoon erupted with brilliant light. The golden chains binding him began breaking one by one. Meanwhile, countless remnant shadows of past chess players poured out from the Tianji Record fragment, their unified roar surging toward the Heavenly Eye like a tide. Mo Xiansheng's voice exploded in Chen Ji's ear: "Now! Write its name with the Tianji Record—only by writing its name can you truly hurt it!"

choices.description: The more confident the Heavenly Eye is, the more it shows it hasn't fully seen through you. Counterattack in ways it didn't anticipate.
choices.visible_reward: May interrupt the Heavenly Eye's gaze, gaining brief freedom of action
choices.risk_hint: Enormous consumption, if failed will completely expose all trump cards

text.content: "You say I'm on your chessboard?" Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a mad golden light flashing in his eyes. "Then I'll smash your chessboard—!" He poured all his Heavenly Fate value unreservedly into the Tianji Record. The fragment instantly ignited, golden flames illuminating the entire darkness. Chen Ji used blood as ink and wrote a character on the burning page—"Eye".

The Heavenly Eye's pupils violently contracted. On that face composed of countless chessboards, a look of upheaval appeared for the first time. "You're insane! Writing my name requires—" Before it could finish, the burning Tianji Record erupted with power足以撕裂虚空的力量，将那双眼睛周围的黑暗灼烧出一个巨大的空洞。陈天命趁此机会挣脱了最后一根锁链，伸手抓住了茧房中的核心碎片。"机儿，接住！"

choices.text: Use Chen Nian's bond to counterattack
choices.description: The Tianji Record's foresight of Chen Nian is always blurry—that's not interference, it's protection. Use this blind spot to break through the Heavenly Eye's calculations.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing Chen Nian's existence may invite greater danger
choices.visible_reward: Utilize the Heavenly Eye's logical blind spot to open a completely new situation
choices.risk_hint: Once Chen Nian's information is exposed, may be targeted by the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of madness. "You say I'm on your chessboard, everything is in your plans... then what about my sister?" The Heavenly Eye's pupils paused slightly. "Chen Nian—the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, that girl you took from me." Chen Ji's voice abruptly turned cold. "Did your foresight ever include her?"

Silence. Endless silence. Those eyes revealed a puzzled expression for the first time—this was the first time Chen Ji saw genuine upheaval on that existence transcending everything. "That girl..." The Heavenly Eye's voice finally carried a hint of uncertainty. "She is not within Heavenly Secrets. She is... a variable." Chen Ji seized this moment to charge toward the cocoon, while the Tianji Record's fragment began flipping frantically. A line of never-before-seen text was slowly emerging—the Tianji Record's complete foresight of Chen Nian!

In that fleeting moment, the cocoon completely collapsed. Chen Tianming's figure broke free from the golden chains, weak yet still towering like a mountain. He grabbed Chen Ji's wrist and stuffed the broken Tianji Record core into his son's palm. "Enough." Chen Tianming's voice was hoarse yet firm. "You've proven yourself. Now, let father and son... flip this chess game together."

The Heavenly Eye finally opened fully. Those were eyes beyond description—no whites, no pupils, only a chaotic void reflecting the birth and death of countless worlds. "Interesting." Its voice rang from all directions simultaneously. "The forty-ninth piece finally shows its fangs. But do you think, with a broken chess player plus an incomplete Tianji Record, you can challenge Heaven?" Those eyes slowly blinked, and the surrounding darkness began frantically contracting.

"I've waited for this moment, for three thousand years." Chen Tianming's voice suddenly became loud and resonant, as if returning to that spirited chess player from a thousand years ago. "You think you've won? You think you've trapped me? No, Heavenly Eye—the one you've trapped... is yourself." Chen Ji looked down at the Tianji Record core in his hand, where an image he had never seen was slowly emerging: the true body of the Heavenly Eye wasn't those eyes at all, but—the vast and boundless chessboard beneath its feet.
In the void, the eyes that transcended the Heavenly Way fully opened, staring directly at Chen Ji—it saw Chen Ji, and Chen Ji finally saw it.
